os: macOS x86_64 via Rosetta 2 (conda osx-64 Python 2.7.15 environment)

preparation.base: Conda osx-64 Python 2.7 environment (biopython 1.76, numpy 1.16.5, scipy 1.2.1, scikit-learn 0.19.2, hmmlearn 0.2.1, peakutils 1.1.0, swig 4.0.2, samtools 1.18, bwa 0.7.18, trf 4.10) with compiled SWIG C extension `_UnsymmetricPairAlignment.so`
preparation.without_preparation: Automated verification stopped before installation (`UNVERIFIED_INSUFFICIENT_DOCS`) because `README.md` delegates installation to `docs/Install.md`, where the documented build path contains a directory typo (`cd bin/scripts/UnsymmetricPairAlignment` instead of `bin/RepeatHMM_scripts/UnsymmetricPairAlignment`) and `environment.yml` pins Linux-only glibc package build hashes (`_libgcc_mutex`, `libgcc-ng`) for Python 2.7.
why: Automated verification stopped before installation (`UNVERIFIED_INSUFFICIENT_DOCS`) because `README.md` contains no installation commands, and `docs/Install.md` references a non-existent directory path (`bin/scripts/UnsymmetricPairAlignment` instead of `bin/RepeatHMM_scripts/UnsymmetricPairAlignment`).

`environment.yml` pins Linux-specific conda build strings (`h7b6447c_0`, `_libgcc_mutex`, `libgcc-ng`) and Python 2.7 (`dict.has_key`, `string.strip`), which cannot be created verbatim on modern platforms without relaxing platform build hashes and pinning `scikit-learn=0.19.2` and `libcxx<15`.

Although `docs/Usage.md` states `Default=0: not use SplitAndReAlign` for `--SplitAndReAlign`, `bin/repeatHMM.py` sets the parser default to `1` (which invokes `bwa mem` and requires a full BWA index alongside `hg38.fa`); passing `--SplitAndReAlign 0` runs the direct BAM + unsymmetric alignment + HMM/GMM caller cleanly on the indexed BAM and `hg38.fa`.
steps: Cloned `https://github.com/WGLab/RepeatHMM` at commit `fa6c108fa0cc8ab344577147e52a8fcc3adde990` without modifying any file in the checkout.

Created an isolated `osx-64` conda environment with `python=2.7`, `numpy`, `scipy`, `scikit-learn=0.19.2`, `biopython`, `hmmlearn==0.2.1`, `peakutils==1.1.0`, `libcxx<15`, `swig`, `samtools`, `bwa`, `trf`, and `make`.

Built the SWIG C extension (`make` inside `bin/RepeatHMM_scripts/UnsymmetricPairAlignment` in a separate build copy `/src/RepeatHMM`) to produce `_UnsymmetricPairAlignment.so` while keeping the upstream checkout untouched.

Prepared `/data/in/codis.pa` with the 20 CODIS loci in RepeatHMM's 8-column `.pa` format (18 predefined CODIS entries from `bin/reference_sts/hg38/hg38.predefined.pa` plus `fga` and `vwa`), staged `HG00113.codis.bam` (+ `.bai`) and `hg38.fa` (+ `.fai`), and ran `repeatHMM.py BAMinput --SeqTech Nanopore --SplitAndReAlign 0 --repeatName all`.
preparation.run_cmd: cd /data/out && python /src/RepeatHMM/bin/repeatHMM.py BAMinput --Onebamfile /data/in/sample.bam --hg hg38 --hgfile /data/in/hg38.fa --Patternfile /data/in/codis.pa --SeqTech Nanopore --SplitAndReAlign 0 --repeatName all --outFolder /data/out/align

recommendations: Fix the directory path in `docs/Install.md` (line 12) from `cd bin/scripts/UnsymmetricPairAlignment` to `cd bin/RepeatHMM_scripts/UnsymmetricPairAlignment`, and include the installation block directly in `README.md`.

Remove OS-specific conda build hashes and `_libgcc_mutex` / `libgcc-ng` from `environment.yml` (keeping only portable package version constraints such as `python=2.7`, `scikit-learn=0.19.2`, `hmmlearn=0.2.1`, `peakutils=1.1.0`, `biopython`, `swig`, `samtools`, `bwa`, `trf`), or migrate the codebase to Python 3 (`dict.has_key` and `string.strip`).

Align the `--SplitAndReAlign` default in `bin/repeatHMM.py` with `docs/Usage.md` (`default=0` for pre-aligned BAMs) so `BAMinput` runs out of the box without requiring a BWA index when a coordinate-sorted BAM and `hg38.fa` are provided.

verdict.title: Runs in manual verification
verdict.reason: Built unmodified upstream RepeatHMM v2.0.3 (`fa6c108`) in an isolated `osx-64` Python 2.7 conda environment (compiling the SWIG C extension `_UnsymmetricPairAlignment.so` in a separate build copy with zero upstream source modifications) and ran `repeatHMM.py BAMinput --SeqTech Nanopore --SplitAndReAlign 0 --repeatName all` against the HG00113 Oxford Nanopore R10 SUP CODIS reference slice (`ont-bam-hg38`, 20 autosomal CODIS loci in RepeatHMM `.pa` pattern format) and local `hg38.fa`. es.plain_why: RepeatHMM v2.0.3 compila limpiamente su extensión SWIG de alineamiento en un entorno conda con Python 2.7 y genotipifica los 20/20 loci CODIS del slice de referencia ONT R10 SUP sin modificaciones al código fuente.
es.without_preparation: La verificación automática se detuvo antes de la instalación (`UNVERIFIED_INSUFFICIENT_DOCS`) porque `README.md` delega la instalación a `docs/Install.md`, donde la ruta de compilación tiene un error tipográfico (`cd bin/scripts/UnsymmetricPairAlignment` en lugar de `bin/RepeatHMM_scripts/UnsymmetricPairAlignment`) y `environment.yml` fija hashes de paquetes exclusivos de Linux (`_libgcc_mutex`, `libgcc-ng`) para Python 2.7.
recommendations: Corregir la ruta en `docs/Install.md` (línea 12) de `cd bin/scripts/UnsymmetricPairAlignment` a `cd bin/RepeatHMM_scripts/UnsymmetricPairAlignment` e incluir el bloque de instalación directamente en `README.md`.

Quitar los hashes de compilación específicos de sistema operativo y `_libgcc_mutex` / `libgcc-ng` de `environment.yml` (dejando solo versiones portables como `python=2.7`, `scikit-learn=0.19.2`, `hmmlearn=0.2.1`, `peakutils=1.1.0`, `biopython`, `swig`, `samtools`, `bwa`, `trf`), o migrar el código a Python 3 (`dict.has_key` y `string.strip`).

Alinear el valor por defecto de `--SplitAndReAlign` en `bin/repeatHMM.py` con `docs/Usage.md` (`default=0` para BAMs ya alineados) para que `BAMinput` corra sin exigir un índice BWA cuando se proveen un BAM ordenado y `hg38.fa`.

pt.plain_why: RepeatHMM v2.0.3 compila limpamente sua extensão SWIG de alinhamento em um ambiente conda Python 2.7 e genotipa todos os 20/20 loci CODIS no recorte de referência ONT R10 SUP sem modificações no código-fonte.
pt.without_preparation: A verificação automática parou antes da instalação (`UNVERIFIED_INSUFFICIENT_DOCS`) porque o `README.md` delega a instalação para `docs/Install.md`, onde o caminho de compilação contém um erro de diretório (`cd bin/scripts/UnsymmetricPairAlignment` em vez de `bin/RepeatHMM_scripts/UnsymmetricPairAlignment`) e `environment.yml` fixa hashes de pacotes exclusivos de Linux (`_libgcc_mutex`, `libgcc-ng`) para Python 2.7.
recommendations: Corrigir o caminho em `docs/Install.md` (linha 12) de `cd bin/scripts/UnsymmetricPairAlignment` para `cd bin/RepeatHMM_scripts/UnsymmetricPairAlignment` e incluir o bloco de instalação diretamente no `README.md`.

Remover hashes de build específicos de sistema operacional e `_libgcc_mutex` / `libgcc-ng` do `environment.yml` (mantendo apenas restrições portáteis como `python=2.7`, `scikit-learn=0.19.2`, `hmmlearn=0.2.1`, `peakutils=1.1.0`, `biopython`, `swig`, `samtools`, `bwa`, `trf`), ou migrar o código para Python 3 (`dict.has_key` e `string.strip`).

Alinhar o padrão de `--SplitAndReAlign` em `bin/repeatHMM.py` com `docs/Usage.md` (`default=0` para BAMs já alinhados) para que `BAMinput` funcione diretamente sem exigir um índice BWA quando um BAM ordenado e `hg38.fa` são fornecidos.
